notes:
Account profile: midsize CCaaS vendor that resells to B2B SaaS customers. Core product: multichannel ticketing + automation. They run peak traffic patterns (EOD/launch spikes) and have frequent refund workflows tied to Stripe and internal billing. Key ask: tool-calls from the assistant to their systems must be safe, idempotent, auditable.

Highlights and customer voice: 
- Wants 'one API' for agents: summarize last 3 interactions, propose ticket updates, call refund endpoint when approved.
- 'We need absolute guarantees on no double-refunds' — finance emphasized idempotency & reversal path.
- Concerned about SLA during Black Friday-like spikes; asked about autoscaling, queueing, and graceful degradation to cheaper model variants.

Technical constraints: 
- Integrations: Zendesk + ServiceNow + in-house ticket API (REST) + Stripe. Need tool-calls to support create/update/comment/escalate/refund.
- Must support audit logs per call, signed events, and retention controls (EU residency for some customers).
- Prefers private VPC deployment with KMS-managed keys; later interest in on-prem for top-tier customers.
- Wants ability to pin model versions and fallback rules (small/fast model for high-throughput, full model for L2 suggestions).

POC success criteria (customer-provided): 
- End-to-end tool-call: agent triggers refund -> POC processes refund via Stripe sandbox with idempotency key and logs -> no duplicates in 1000 concurrent scenarios.
- Ticket summarization latency < 500ms median for agent UI; background rerank for triage within 2s.
- No auth/secrets exposed; audit trail stored in customer-managed S3 for 90 days.

Next tacticals: 
- Deliver API mapping doc + sample call harness (Ethan/Sofia).
- Security: provide SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration notes, possible on-prem demo dates.
- Prepare controlled spike test plan (1000 concurrent tool-calls) and failure-mode report.

Stitch notes: shorthand, partial quotes above. Drive: pricing + security FAQ links attached. Jira: INFRA-902 for POC infra; SEC-1743 for security evidence request.
use_case_summary: Primary: agent-assist that can create and update tickets via tool-calls; secondary: automated refunds and escalation to L2 with audit trail. Emphasis on high reliability during traffic spikes and idempotent external API interactions.
technical_requirements: Must support: signed tool-calls, idempotency keys, retry semantics, audit logs exported to customer S3, KMS integration for secrets, EU data residency option. Need SDKs or sample harness for Zendesk/ServiceNow/Stripe. Live canary + fallback policies required.
procurement_notes: Legal: standard enterprise T&Cs requested; wants DPA + data residency clause. Procurement awaiting security sign-off before contract. Finance wants clear refund-domain SLAs to cap liability.
competitive_signals: Evaluating ServiceNow for end-to-end; Zendesk remains entrenched in field; building own lightweight automation stack. Interested in Redwood's cost controls (Optimize) and private deployment for compliance.
final_notes_for_sales: Focus on POC with concrete artifacts: mapping doc, sample tool-call harness, spike test plan. Bring security pack early (SOC2, KMS integration notes). Emphasize deterministic reranker option and fallback models for graceful degradation. Close window target: 2026-05.
